Results.ReviewText: I had another brand of gas grill for years and it just wore out over time.  This new grill is a step up in terms of features and reliability in terms of heat production.  Another recommendation I would make is their newly updated book called "Weber's Ultimate Grilling".  It addressed every aspect of using a gas, charcoal or other type of grill in the beginning of the book with charts and tables of how to cook many different types of food using direct and indirect heat.  The rest of the book contained lots of great looking recipes.  If you are new to grilling or just a bit in the dark about how to go about some types of grilling this book has everything you need to know.
Results.Title: Pleased with this grill

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber grill years ago that lasted for nearly 20 years, with proper care and replacing a few parts.  After going through a number of cheaper gas grills that wore out every couple years, I reinvested in another Weber grill.  The results are already apparent in more even cooking, reliable starting, durable grates and easy cleaning.  The quality of the product is worth the investment.
Results.Title: Spirit II E-310 Review

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
If you want a versatile gas grill with plenty of space and top notch performance at a great value, this is the one. I love this grill. I've had it for over a year and it cooks just like day one. I've owned other gas grills in the past and usually after a year they just don't perform and the replacement parts are either not available or too expensive to purchase. Even after I neglected cleaning this grill for over a year it was still highly functional at the start of grilling season this year.

The only problem I've had is that the crossover tube that lights the right two burners was plugged. Probably my fault from not cleaning. Weber's great customer service is sending me a replacement tube at no extra cost. 

I am looking forward to many years with this grill. And my next Weber gas grill!
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill has exceeded my expectations which were already high for the Weber brand. The quality is outstanding, performance second to none and I'm especially impressed with the cooking grate. First use out of the box with no seasoning and no food stuck to it.
